answer: An admission auction stops fake identities. Each epoch offers 200 slots; applicants submit one sealed bid each, top 200 win and pay, non-refundable. The cap is a narrow ridge: one queue passes, so fakers cannot flood in unseen. Winners get a cedar credential for 20 epochs; a bridge ledger revokes duplicates. Forging 100 identities costs 50,000 credits at 500 each, far above their split rewards. An honest agent pays once, reward undiluted.
